ayahs.textUthmani: وَنُنَزِّلُ مِنَ ٱلْقُرْءَانِ مَا هُوَ شِفَآءٌ وَرَحْمَةٌ لِّلْمُؤْمِنِينَ ۙ وَلَا يَزِيدُ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ إِلَّا خَسَارًا
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَنُنَزِّلُ مِنَ ٱلْقُرْءَانِ مَا هُوَ شِفَآءٌ وَرَحْمَةٌ لِّلْمُؤْمِنِينَ‌ۙ وَلَا يَزِيدُ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ إِلَّا خَسَارًا ۝٨٢
ayahs.textIndopak: وَنُنَزِّلُ مِنَ الْقُرْاٰنِ مَا هُوَ شِفَا࢜ءٌ وَّرَحْمَةٌ لِّلْمُو͏ٔ͏ْمِنِيْنَۙ وَلَا يَزِيْدُ الظّٰلِمِيْنَ اِلَّا خَسَارًا
ayahs.translation: And We send down of the Qur’ān that which is healing and mercy for the believers, but it does not increase the wrongdoers except in loss.
ayahs.transliteration: Wanunazzilu minal-qur'aani maa huwa shifaa'un warahmatul lilmu'mineena walaa yazeeduz-zaalimeena illaa khasaaraa
ayahs.translationClear: We send down in the Quran healing and mercy for the believers, but it increases the wrongdoers only in loss.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَإِذَآ أَنْعَمْنَا عَلَى ٱلْإِنسَـٰنِ أَعْرَضَ وَنَـَٔا بِجَانِبِهِۦ ۖ وَإِذَا مَسَّهُ ٱلشَّرُّ كَانَ يَـُٔوسًا
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَإِذَآ أَنْعَمْنَا عَلَى ٱلْإِنسَـٰنِ أَعْرَضَ وَنَـَٔا بِجَانِبِهِۦ‌ۖ وَإِذَا مَسَّهُ ٱلشَّرُّ كَانَ يَـُٔوسًا ۝٨٣
ayahs.textIndopak: وَاِذَا͏ٓ اَنْعَمْنَا عَلَي الْاِنْسَانِ اَعْرَضَ وَنَاٰ بِجَانِبِهٖۚ وَاِذَا مَسَّهُ الشَّرُّ كَانَ يَـٔ͏ُوْسًا
ayahs.translation: And when We bestow favor upon man [i.e., the disbeliever], he turns away and distances himself; and when evil touches him, he is ever despairing.
ayahs.transliteration: Wa'idhaa an'amnaa 'alal-insaani a'rada wana'aa bijaanibihee wa'idhaa massahush-sharru kaana ya'oosaa
ayahs.translationClear: When We bless the human being, he turns away and distances himself. But when adversity touches him, he is in despair.

ayahs.textUthmani: قُلْ كُلٌّ يَعْمَلُ عَلَىٰ شَاكِلَتِهِۦ فَرَبُّكُمْ أَعْلَمُ بِمَنْ هُوَ أَهْدَىٰ سَبِيلًا
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قُلْ كُلٌّ يَعْمَلُ عَلَىٰ شَاكِلَتِهِۦ فَرَبُّكُمْ أَعْلَمُ بِمَنْ هُوَ أَهْدَىٰ سَبِيلًا ۝٨٤
ayahs.textIndopak: قُلْ كُلٌّ يَّعْمَلُ عَلٰي شَاكِلَتِهٖؕ فَرَبُّكُمْ اَعْلَمُ بِمَنْ هُوَ اَهْدٰي سَبِيْلًا ࣖ
ayahs.translation: Say, "Each works according to his manner, but your Lord is most knowing of who is best guided in way."
ayahs.transliteration: Qul kullun ya'malu 'alaa shaakilatihee farabbukum a'lamu biman huwa ahdaa sabeelaa
ayahs.translationClear: Say, “Each does according to his disposition. Your Lord knows best who is better guided in the way.”

ayahs.textUthmani: وَيَسْـَٔلُونَكَ عَنِ ٱلرُّوحِ ۖ قُلِ ٱلرُّوحُ مِنْ أَمْرِ رَبِّى وَمَآ أُوتِيتُم مِّنَ ٱلْعِلْمِ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَيَسْـَٔلُونَكَ عَنِ ٱلرُّوحِ‌ۖ قُلِ ٱلرُّوحُ مِنْ أَمْرِ رَبِّى وَمَآ أُوتِيتُم مِّنَ ٱلْعِلْمِ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا ۝٨٥
ayahs.textIndopak: وَيَسْـٔ͏َلُوْنَكَ عَنِ الرُّوْحِؕ قُلِ الرُّوْحُ مِنْ اَمْرِ رَبِّيْ وَمَا͏ٓ اُوْتِيْتُمْ مِّنَ الْعِلْمِ اِلَّا قَلِيْلًا
ayahs.translation: And they ask you, [O Muḥammad], about the soul. Say, "The soul is of the affair [i.e., concern] of my Lord. And you [i.e., mankind] have not been given of knowledge except a little."
ayahs.transliteration: Wayas'aloonaka 'anir-roohi qulir-roohu min amri rabbee wamaa ooteetum minal-'ilmi illaa qaleelaa
ayahs.translationClear: And they ask you about the Spirit. Say, “The Spirit belongs to the domain of my Lord; and you were given only little knowledge.”

ayahs.textUthmani: وَلَئِن شِئْنَا لَنَذْهَبَنَّ بِٱلَّذِىٓ أَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَيْكَ ثُمَّ لَا تَجِدُ لَكَ بِهِۦ عَلَيْنَا وَكِيلًا
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَلَئِن شِئْنَا لَنَذْهَبَنَّ بِٱلَّذِىٓ أَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَيْكَ ثُمَّ لَا تَجِدُ لَكَ بِهِۦ عَلَيْنَا وَكِيلًا ۝٨٦
ayahs.textIndopak: وَلَىِٕنْ شِي͏ٔ͏ْنَا لَنَذْهَبَنَّ بِالَّذِيْٓ اَوْحَيْنَا͏ٓ اِلَيْكَ ثُمَّ لَا تَجِدُ لَكَ بِهٖ عَلَيْنَا وَكِيْلًا ۙ
ayahs.translation: And if We willed, We could surely do away with that which We revealed to you. Then you would not find for yourself concerning it an advocate against Us.
ayahs.transliteration: Wala'in shi'naa lanadhhabanna bil-ladhee awhaynaa ilayka thumma laa tajidu laka bihee 'alaynaa wakeelaa
ayahs.translationClear: If We willed, We could take away what We revealed to you. Then you will find for yourself no protecting guardian against Us.

ayahs.textUthmani: إِلَّا رَحْمَةً مِّن رَّبِّكَ ۚ إِنَّ فَضْلَهُۥ كَانَ عَلَيْكَ كَبِيرًا
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِلَّا رَحْمَةً مِّن رَّبِّكَ‌ۚ إِنَّ فَضْلَهُۥ كَانَ عَلَيْكَ كَبِيرًا ۝٨٧
ayahs.textIndopak: اِلَّا رَحْمَةً مِّنْ رَّبِّكَؕ اِنَّ فَضْلَهٗ كَانَ عَلَيْكَ كَبِيْرًا
ayahs.translation: Except [We have left it with you] as a mercy from your Lord. Indeed, His favor upon you has ever been great.
ayahs.transliteration: Illaa rahmatam mir rabbika inna fadlahoo kaana 'alayka kabeeraa
ayahs.translationClear: Except through a mercy from your Lord. His favors upon you have been great.

ayahs.textUthmani: قُل لَّئِنِ ٱجْتَمَعَتِ ٱلْإِنسُ وَٱلْجِنُّ عَلَىٰٓ أَن يَأْتُوا۟ بِمِثْلِ هَـٰذَا ٱلْقُرْءَانِ لَا يَأْتُونَ بِمِثْلِهِۦ وَلَوْ كَانَ بَعْضُهُمْ لِبَعْضٍ ظَهِيرًا
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قُل لَّئِنِ ٱجْتَمَعَتِ ٱلْإِنسُ وَٱلْجِنُّ عَلَىٰٓ أَن يَأْتُوا۟ بِمِثْلِ هَـٰذَا ٱلْقُرْءَانِ لَا يَأْتُونَ بِمِثْلِهِۦ وَلَوْ كَانَ بَعْضُهُمْ لِبَعْضٍ ظَهِيرًا ۝٨٨
ayahs.textIndopak: قُلْ لَّىِٕنِ اجْتَمَعَتِ الْاِنْسُ وَالْجِنُّ عَلٰٓي اَنْ يَّاْتُوْا بِمِثْلِ هٰذَا الْقُرْاٰنِ لَا يَاْتُوْنَ بِمِثْلِهٖ وَلَوْ كَانَ بَعْضُهُمْ لِبَعْضٍ ظَهِيْرًا
ayahs.translation: Say, "If mankind and the jinn gathered in order to produce the like of this Qur’ān, they could not produce the like of it, even if they were to each other assistants."
ayahs.transliteration: Qul la'inijtama'atil-insu wal-jinnu 'alaa an ya'too bimithli haadhal-qur'aani laa ya'toona bimithlihee walaw kaana ba'duhum liba'din zaheeraa
ayahs.translationClear: Say, “If mankind and jinn came together to produce the like of this Quran, they could never produce the like of it, even if they backed up one another.”

ayahs.textUthmani: وَلَقَدْ صَرَّفْنَا لِلنَّاسِ فِى هَـٰذَا ٱلْقُرْءَانِ مِن كُلِّ مَثَلٍ فَأَبَىٰٓ أَكْثَرُ ٱلنَّاسِ إِلَّا كُفُورًا
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَلَقَدْ صَرَّفْنَا لِلنَّاسِ فِى هَـٰذَا ٱلْقُرْءَانِ مِن كُلِّ مَثَلٍ فَأَبَىٰٓ أَكْثَرُ ٱلنَّاسِ إِلَّا كُفُورًا ۝٨٩
ayahs.textIndopak: وَلَقَدْ صَرَّفْنَا لِلنَّاسِ فِيْ هٰذَا الْقُرْاٰنِ مِنْ كُلِّ مَثَلٍؗ فَاَبٰٓي اَكْثَرُ النَّاسِ اِلَّا كُفُوْرًا
ayahs.translation: And We have certainly diversified for the people in this Qur’ān from every [kind of] example, but most of the people refused except disbelief.
ayahs.transliteration: Walaqad sarrafnaa linnaasi fee haadhal-qur'aani min kulli mathalin fa'abaa aktharun-naasi illaa kufooraa
ayahs.translationClear: We have displayed for mankind in this Quran every kind of similitude, but most people insist on denying the truth.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَقَالُوا۟ لَن نُّؤْمِنَ لَكَ حَتَّىٰ تَفْجُرَ لَنَا مِنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ يَنۢبُوعًا
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَقَالُوا۟ لَن نُّؤْمِنَ لَكَ حَتَّىٰ تَفْجُرَ لَنَا مِنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ يَنۢبُوعًا ۝٩٠
ayahs.textIndopak: وَقَالُوْا لَنْ نُّو͏ٔ͏ْمِنَ لَكَ حَتّٰي تَفْجُرَ لَنَا مِنَ الْاَرْضِ يَنۢ͏ْبُوْعًا ۙ
ayahs.translation: And they say, "We will not believe you until you break open for us from the ground a spring
ayahs.transliteration: Waqaaloo lan nu'mina laka hattaa tafjura lanaa minal-ardi yamboo'aa
ayahs.translationClear: And they said, “We will not believe in you unless you make a spring burst from the ground for us.

ayahs.textUthmani: أَوْ تَكُونَ لَكَ جَنَّةٌ مِّن نَّخِيلٍ وَعِنَبٍ فَتُفَجِّرَ ٱلْأَنْهَـٰرَ خِلَـٰلَهَا تَفْجِيرًا
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: أَوْ تَكُونَ لَكَ جَنَّةٌ مِّن نَّخِيلٍ وَعِنَبٍ فَتُفَجِّرَ ٱلْأَنْهَـٰرَ خِلَـٰلَهَا تَفْجِيرًا ۝٩١
ayahs.textIndopak: اَوْ تَكُوْنَ لَكَ جَنَّةٌ مِّنْ نَّخِيْلٍ وَّعِنَبٍ فَتُفَجِّرَ الْاَنْهٰرَ خِلٰلَهَا تَفْجِيْرًا ۙ
ayahs.translation: Or [until] you have a garden of palm trees and grapes and make rivers gush forth within them in force [and abundance]
ayahs.transliteration: Aw takoona laka jannatum min nakheelin wa'inabin fatufajjiral-anhaara khilaalahaa tafjeeraa
ayahs.translationClear: Or you have a garden of palms and vines; then cause rivers to gush pouring through them.

ayahs.textUthmani: أَوْ تُسْقِطَ ٱلسَّمَآءَ كَمَا زَعَمْتَ عَلَيْنَا كِسَفًا أَوْ تَأْتِىَ بِٱللَّهِ وَٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةِ قَبِيلًا
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: أَوْ تُسْقِطَ ٱلسَّمَآءَ كَمَا زَعَمْتَ عَلَيْنَا كِسَفًا أَوْ تَأْتِىَ بِٱللَّهِ وَٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةِ قَبِيلًا ۝٩٢
ayahs.textIndopak: اَوْ تُسْقِطَ السَّمَا࢜ءَ كَمَا زَعَمْتَ عَلَيْنَا كِسَفًا اَوْ تَاْتِيَ بِاللّٰهِ وَالْمَلٰ࢜ىِٕكَةِ قَبِيْلًا ۙ
ayahs.translation: Or you make the heaven fall upon us in fragments as you have claimed or you bring Allāh and the angels before [us]
ayahs.transliteration: Aw tusqitas-samaa'a kamaa za'amta 'alaynaa kisafan aw ta'tiya billaahi wal-malaa'ikati qabeelaa
ayahs.translationClear: Or make the sky fall on us in pieces, as you claim, or bring Allah and the angels before us.

ayahs.textUthmani: أَوْ يَكُونَ لَكَ بَيْتٌ مِّن زُخْرُفٍ أَوْ تَرْقَىٰ فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَلَن نُّؤْمِنَ لِرُقِيِّكَ حَتَّىٰ تُنَزِّلَ عَلَيْنَا كِتَـٰبًا نَّقْرَؤُهُۥ ۗ قُلْ سُبْحَانَ رَبِّى هَلْ كُنتُ إِلَّا بَشَرًا رَّسُولًا
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: أَوْ يَكُونَ لَكَ بَيْتٌ مِّن زُخْرُفٍ أَوْ تَرْقَىٰ فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَلَن نُّؤْمِنَ لِرُقِيِّكَ حَتَّىٰ تُنَزِّلَ عَلَيْنَا كِتَـٰبًا نَّقْرَؤُهُۥ‌ۗ قُلْ سُبْحَانَ رَبِّى هَلْ كُنتُ إِلَّا بَشَرًا رَّسُولًا ۝٩٣
ayahs.textIndopak: اَوْ يَكُوْنَ لَكَ بَيْتٌ مِّنْ زُخْرُفٍ اَوْ تَرْقٰي فِي السَّمَا࢜ءِؕ وَلَنْ نُّو͏ٔ͏ْمِنَ لِرُقِيِّكَ حَتّٰي تُنَزِّلَ عَلَيْنَا كِتٰبًا نَّقْرَو͏ٔ͏ُهٗؕ قُلْ سُبْحَانَ رَبِّيْ هَلْ كُنْتُ اِلَّا بَشَرًا رَّسُوْلًا ࣖ
ayahs.translation: Or you have a house of ornament [i.e., gold] or you ascend into the sky. And [even then], we will not believe in your ascension until you bring down to us a book we may read." Say, "Exalted is my Lord! Was I ever but a human messenger?"
ayahs.transliteration: Aw yakoona laka baytum min zukhrufin aw tarqaa fis-samaa'i walan nu'mina liruqiyyika hattaa tunazzila 'alaynaa kitaaban naqra'uhoo qul subhaana rabbee hal kuntu illaa basharar rasoolaa
ayahs.translationClear: Or you possess a house of gold. Or you ascend into the sky. Even then, we will not believe in your ascension, unless you bring down for us a book that we can read.” Say, “Glory be to my Lord. Am I anything but a human messenger?”

ayahs.textUthmani: وَمَا مَنَعَ ٱلنَّاسَ أَن يُؤْمِنُوٓا۟ إِذْ جَآءَهُمُ ٱلْهُدَىٰٓ إِلَّآ أَن قَالُوٓا۟ أَبَعَثَ ٱللَّهُ بَشَرًا رَّسُولًا
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَمَا مَنَعَ ٱلنَّاسَ أَن يُؤْمِنُوٓا۟ إِذْ جَآءَهُمُ ٱلْهُدَىٰٓ إِلَّآ أَن قَالُوٓا۟ أَبَعَثَ ٱللَّهُ بَشَرًا رَّسُولًا ۝٩٤
ayahs.textIndopak: وَمَا مَنَعَ النَّاسَ اَنْ يُّو͏ٔ͏ْمِنُوْٓا اِذْ جَا࢜ءَهُمُ الْهُدٰٓي اِلَّا͏ٓ اَنْ قَالُوْٓا اَبَعَثَ اللّٰهُ بَشَرًا رَّسُوْلًا
ayahs.translation: And what prevented the people from believing when guidance came to them except that they said, "Has Allāh sent a human messenger?"
ayahs.transliteration: Wamaa mana'an-naasa an yu'minoo idh jaa'ahumul-hudaa illaa an qaaloo aba'athallaahu basharar rasoolaa
ayahs.translationClear: Nothing prevented the people from believing, when guidance has come to them, except that they said, “Did Allah send a human messenger?”

ayahs.textUthmani: قُل لَّوْ كَانَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ مَلَـٰٓئِكَةٌ يَمْشُونَ مُطْمَئِنِّينَ لَنَزَّلْنَا عَلَيْهِم مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَلَكًا رَّسُولًا
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قُل لَّوْ كَانَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ مَلَـٰٓئِكَةٌ يَمْشُونَ مُطْمَئِنِّينَ لَنَزَّلْنَا عَلَيْهِم مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَلَكًا رَّسُولًا ۝٩٥
ayahs.textIndopak: قُلْ لَّوْ كَانَ فِي الْاَرْضِ مَلٰ࢜ىِٕكَةٌ يَّمْشُوْنَ مُطْمَىِٕنِّيْنَ لَنَزَّلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ مِّنَ السَّمَا࢜ءِ مَلَكًا رَّسُوْلًا
ayahs.translation: Say, "If there were upon the earth angels walking securely,[774] We would have sent down to them from the heaven an angel [as a] messenger."
ayahs.transliteration: Qul law kaana fil-ardi malaa'ikatun yamshoona mutma'inneena lanazzalnaa 'alayhim minas-samaa'i malakar rasoolaa

footnotes.774: i.e., who were settled and established there, as is man.

ayahs.translationClear: Say, “If there were angels on earth, walking around in peace, We would have sent down to them from heaven an angel messenger.”

ayahs.textUthmani: قُلْ كَفَىٰ بِٱللَّهِ شَهِيدًۢا بَيْنِى وَبَيْنَكُمْ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ بِعِبَادِهِۦ خَبِيرًۢا بَصِيرًا
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قُلْ كَفَىٰ بِٱللَّهِ شَهِيدًۢا بَيْنِى وَبَيْنَكُمْ‌ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ بِعِبَادِهِۦ خَبِيرًۢا بَصِيرًا ۝٩٦
ayahs.textIndopak: قُلْ كَفٰي بِاللّٰهِ شَهِيْدًاۢ بَيْنِيْ وَبَيْنَكُمْؕ اِنَّهٗ كَانَ بِعِبَادِهٖ خَبِيْرًاۢ بَصِيْرًا
ayahs.translation: Say, "Sufficient is Allāh as Witness between me and you. Indeed He is ever, concerning His servants, Aware and Seeing."
ayahs.transliteration: Qul kafaa billaahi shaheedam baynee wabaynakum innahoo kaana bi'ibaadihee khabeeram baseeraa
ayahs.translationClear: Say, “Allah is enough witness between you and me. He is fully aware of His servants, and He sees them well.”

ayahs.textUthmani: وَمَن يَهْدِ ٱللَّهُ فَهُوَ ٱلْمُهْتَدِ ۖ وَمَن يُضْلِلْ فَلَن تَجِدَ لَهُمْ أَوْلِيَآءَ مِن دُونِهِۦ ۖ وَنَحْشُرُهُمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ عَلَىٰ وُجُوهِهِمْ عُمْيًا وَبُكْمًا وَصُمًّا ۖ مَّأْوَىٰهُمْ جَهَنَّمُ ۖ كُلَّمَا خَبَتْ زِدْنَـٰهُمْ سَعِيرًا
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَمَن يَهْدِ ٱللَّهُ فَهُوَ ٱلْمُهْتَدِ‌ۖ وَمَن يُضْلِلْ فَلَن تَجِدَ لَهُمْ أَوْلِيَآءَ مِن دُونِهِۦ‌ۖ وَنَحْشُرُهُمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ عَلَىٰ وُجُوهِهِمْ عُمْيًا وَبُكْمًا وَصُمًّا‌ۖ مَّأْوَىٰهُمْ جَهَنَّمُ‌ۖ كُلَّمَا خَبَتْ زِدْنَـٰهُمْ سَعِيرًا ۝٩٧
ayahs.textIndopak: وَمَنْ يَّهْدِ اللّٰهُ فَهُوَ الْمُهْتَدِۚ وَمَنْ يُّضْلِلْ فَلَنْ تَجِدَ لَهُمْ اَوْلِيَا࢜ءَ مِنْ دُوْنِهٖؕ وَنَحْشُرُهُمْ يَوْمَ الْقِيٰمَةِ عَلٰي وُجُوْهِهِمْ عُمْيًا وَّبُكْمًا وَّصُمًّاؕ مَاْوٰىهُمْ جَهَنَّمُؕ كُلَّمَا خَبَتْ زِدْنٰهُمْ سَعِيْرًا
ayahs.translation: And whoever Allāh guides - he is the [rightly] guided; and whoever He sends astray[775] - you will never find for them protectors besides Him, and We will gather them on the Day of Resurrection [fallen] on their faces - blind, dumb and deaf. Their refuge is Hell; every time it subsides, We increase [for] them blazing fire.
ayahs.transliteration: Waman yahdillaahu fahuwal-muhtadi waman yudlil falan tajida lahum awliyaa'a min doonihee wanahshuruhum yawmal-qiyaamati 'alaa wujoohihim 'umyan wabukman wasummam ma'waahum jahannamu kullamaa khabat zidnaahum sa'eeraa

footnotes.775: As a result of his own preference.

ayahs.translationClear: Whomever Allah guides is the guided one. And whomever He leaves astray—for them you will find no protectors apart from Him. And We will gather them on the Day of Resurrection, on their faces, blind, dumb, and deaf. Their abode is Hell; whenever it abates, We intensify the blaze for them.

ayahs.textUthmani: ذَٰلِكَ جَزَآؤُهُم بِأَنَّهُمْ كَفَرُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا وَقَالُوٓا۟ أَءِذَا كُنَّا عِظَـٰمًا وَرُفَـٰتًا أَءِنَّا لَمَبْعُوثُونَ خَلْقًا جَدِيدًا
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: ذَٰلِكَ جَزَآؤُهُم بِأَنَّهُمْ كَفَرُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا وَقَالُوٓا۟ أَءِذَا كُنَّا عِظَـٰمًا وَرُفَـٰتًا أَءِنَّا لَمَبْعُوثُونَ خَلْقًا جَدِيدًا ۝٩٨
ayahs.textIndopak: ذٰلِكَ جَزَا࢜و͏ٔ͏ُهُمْ بِاَنَّهُمْ كَفَرُوْا بِاٰيٰتِنَا وَقَالُوْٓا ءَاِذَا كُنَّا عِظَامًا وَّرُفَاتًا ءَاِنَّا لَمَبْعُوْثُوْنَ خَلْقًا جَدِيْدًا
ayahs.translation: That is their recompense because they disbelieved in Our verses and said, "When we are bones and crumbled particles, will we [truly] be resurrected [in] a new creation?"
ayahs.transliteration: Dhaalika jazaa'uhum bi'annahum kafaroo bi'aayaatinaa waqaaloo a'idhaa kunnaa 'izaaman warufaatan a'innaa lamab'oothoona khalqan jadeedaa
ayahs.translationClear: This is their repayment for having blasphemed against Our revelations, and having said, “Shall we, when we have become bones and fragments, be resurrected as a new creation?”

ayahs.textUthmani: ۞ أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ قَادِرٌ عَلَىٰٓ أَن يَخْلُقَ مِثْلَهُمْ وَجَعَلَ لَهُمْ أَجَلًا لَّا رَيْبَ فِيهِ فَأَبَى ٱلظَّـٰلِمُونَ إِلَّا كُفُورًا
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: ۞ أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ قَادِرٌ عَلَىٰٓ أَن يَخْلُقَ مِثْلَهُمْ وَجَعَلَ لَهُمْ أَجَلًا لَّا رَيْبَ فِيهِ فَأَبَى ٱلظَّـٰلِمُونَ إِلَّا كُفُورًا ۝٩٩
ayahs.textIndopak: اَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا اَنَّ اللّٰهَ الَّذِيْ خَلَقَ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالْاَرْضَ قَادِرٌ عَلٰٓي اَنْ يَّخْلُقَ مِثْلَهُمْ وَجَعَلَ لَهُمْ اَجَلًا لَّا رَيْبَ فِيْهِؕ فَاَبَي الظّٰلِمُوْنَ اِلَّا كُفُوْرًا
ayahs.translation: Do they not see that Allāh, who created the heavens and earth, is [the one] Able to create the likes of them? And He has appointed for them a term, about which there is no doubt. But the wrongdoers refuse except disbelief.
ayahs.transliteration: Awalam yaraw annallaahal-ladhee khalaqas-samaawaati wal-arda qaadirun 'alaa an yakhluqa mithlahum waja'ala lahum ajalal laa rayba feehi fa'abaz-zaalimoona illaa kufooraa
ayahs.translationClear: Do they not consider that Allah, who created the heavens and the earth, is Able to create the likes of them? He has assigned for them a term, in which there is no doubt. But the wrongdoers persist in denying the truth.

ayahs.textUthmani: قُل لَّوْ أَنتُمْ تَمْلِكُونَ خَزَآئِنَ رَحْمَةِ رَبِّىٓ إِذًا لَّأَمْسَكْتُمْ خَشْيَةَ ٱلْإِنفَاقِ ۚ وَكَانَ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ قَتُورًا
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قُل لَّوْ أَنتُمْ تَمْلِكُونَ خَزَآئِنَ رَحْمَةِ رَبِّىٓ إِذًا لَّأَمْسَكْتُمْ خَشْيَةَ ٱلْإِنفَاقِ‌ۚ وَكَانَ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ قَتُورًا ۝١٠٠
ayahs.textIndopak: قُلْ لَّوْ اَنْتُمْ تَمْلِكُوْنَ خَزَا࢜ىِٕنَ رَحْمَةِ رَبِّيْٓ اِذًا لَّاَمْسَكْتُمْ خَشْيَةَ الْاِنْفَاقِؕ وَكَانَ الْاِنْسَانُ قَتُوْرًا ࣖ
ayahs.translation: Say [to them], "If you possessed the depositories of the mercy of my Lord, then you would withhold out of fear of spending." And ever has man been stingy.
ayahs.transliteration: Qul law antum tamlikoona khazaa'ina rahmati rabbee idhal la'amsaktum khashyatal-infaaqi wakaanal-insaanu qatooraa
ayahs.translationClear: Say, “If you possessed the treasuries of my Lord’s mercy, you would have withheld them for fear of spending.” The human being has always been stingy.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا مُوسَىٰ تِسْعَ ءَايَـٰتٍۭ بَيِّنَـٰتٍ ۖ فَسْـَٔلْ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ إِذْ جَآءَهُمْ فَقَالَ لَهُۥ فِرْعَوْنُ إِنِّى لَأَظُنُّكَ يَـٰمُوسَىٰ مَسْحُورًا
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا مُوسَىٰ تِسْعَ ءَايَـٰتٍۭ بَيِّنَـٰتٍ‌ۖ فَسْـَٔلْ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ إِذْ جَآءَهُمْ فَقَالَ لَهُۥ فِرْعَوْنُ إِنِّى لَأَظُنُّكَ يَـٰمُوسَىٰ مَسْحُورًا ۝١٠١
ayahs.textIndopak: وَلَقَدْ اٰتَيْنَا مُوْسٰي تِسْعَ اٰيٰتٍۭ بَيِّنٰتٍ فَسْـٔ͏َلْ بَنِيْٓ اِسْرَا࢜ءِيْلَ اِذْ جَا࢜ءَهُمْ فَقَالَ لَهٗ فِرْعَوْنُ اِنِّيْ لَاَظُنُّكَ يٰمُوْسٰي مَسْحُوْرًا
ayahs.translation: And We had certainly given Moses nine evident signs, so ask the Children of Israel [about] when he came to them and Pharaoh said to him, "Indeed I think, O Moses, that you are affected by magic."
ayahs.transliteration: Walaqad aataynaa moosaa tis'a aayaatim bayyinaatin fas'al banee israa'eela idh jaa'ahum faqaala lahoo fir'awnu innee la'azunnuka yaamoosaa mas'hooraa
ayahs.translationClear: We gave Moses nine clear signs—ask the Children of Israel. When he went to them, Pharaoh said to him, “I think that you, Moses, are bewitched.”

ayahs.textUthmani: قَالَ لَقَدْ عَلِمْتَ مَآ أَنزَلَ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ إِلَّا رَبُّ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ بَصَآئِرَ وَإِنِّى لَأَظُنُّكَ يَـٰفِرْعَوْنُ مَثْبُورًا
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قَالَ لَقَدْ عَلِمْتَ مَآ أَنزَلَ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ إِلَّا رَبُّ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ بَصَآئِرَ وَإِنِّى لَأَظُنُّكَ يَـٰفِرْعَوْنُ مَثْبُورًا ۝١٠٢
ayahs.textIndopak: قَالَ لَقَدْ عَلِمْتَ مَا͏ٓ اَنْزَلَ هٰٓو͏ٔ͏ُلَا࢜ءِ اِلَّا رَبُّ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالْاَرْضِ بَصَا࢜ىِٕرَۚ وَاِنِّيْ لَاَظُنُّكَ يٰفِرْعَوْنُ مَثْبُوْرًا
ayahs.translation: [Moses] said, "You have already known that none has sent down these [signs] except the Lord of the heavens and the earth as evidence, and indeed I think,[776] O Pharaoh, that you are destroyed."
ayahs.transliteration: Qaala laqad 'alimta maa anzala haa'ulaa'i illaa rabbus-samaawaati wal-ardi basaa'ira wa'innee la'azunnuka yaafir'awnu mathbooraa
ayahs.translationClear: He said, “You know that none sent these down except the Lord of the heavens and the earth—eye openers; and I think that you, Pharaoh, are doomed.”

ayahs.textUthmani: فَأَرَادَ أَن يَسْتَفِزَّهُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ فَأَغْرَقْنَـٰهُ وَمَن مَّعَهُۥ جَمِيعًا
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَأَرَادَ أَن يَسْتَفِزَّهُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ فَأَغْرَقْنَـٰهُ وَمَن مَّعَهُۥ جَمِيعًا ۝١٠٣
ayahs.textIndopak: فَاَرَادَ اَنْ يَّسْتَفِزَّهُمْ مِّنَ الْاَرْضِ فَاَغْرَقْنٰهُ وَمَنْ مَّعَهٗ جَمِيْعًا ۙ
ayahs.translation: So he intended to drive them from the land, but We drowned him and those with him all together.
ayahs.transliteration: Fa'araada an yastafizzahum minal-ardi fa'aghraqnaahu wamam ma'ahoo jamee'aa
ayahs.translationClear: He resolved to scare them off the land, but We drowned him, and those with him, all together.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَقُلْنَا مِنۢ بَعْدِهِۦ لِبَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ ٱسْكُنُوا۟ ٱلْأَرْضَ فَإِذَا جَآءَ وَعْدُ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ جِئْنَا بِكُمْ لَفِيفًا
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَقُلْنَا مِنۢ بَعْدِهِۦ لِبَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ ٱسْكُنُوا۟ ٱلْأَرْضَ فَإِذَا جَآءَ وَعْدُ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ جِئْنَا بِكُمْ لَفِيفًا ۝١٠٤
ayahs.textIndopak: وَّقُلْنَا مِنْۢ بَعْدِهٖ لِبَنِيْٓ اِسْرَا࢜ءِيْلَ اسْكُنُوا الْاَرْضَ فَاِذَا جَا࢜ءَ وَعْدُ الْاٰخِرَةِ جِي͏ٔ͏ْنَا بِكُمْ لَفِيْفًا ؕ
ayahs.translation: And We said after him [i.e., Pharaoh] to the Children of Israel, "Dwell in the land, and when there comes the promise [i.e., appointment] of the Hereafter, We will bring you forth in [one] gathering."
ayahs.transliteration: Waqulnaa mim ba'dihee libanee israa'eelaskunul-arda fa'idhaa jaa'a wa'dul-aakhirati ji'naa bikum lafeefaa
ayahs.translationClear: After him, We said to the Children of Israel, “Inhabit the land, and when the promise of the Hereafter arrives, We will bring you all together.”

ayahs.textUthmani: وَبِٱلْحَقِّ أَنزَلْنَـٰهُ وَبِٱلْحَقِّ نَزَلَ ۗ وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَـٰكَ إِلَّا مُبَشِّرًا وَنَذِيرًا
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَبِٱلْحَقِّ أَنزَلْنَـٰهُ وَبِٱلْحَقِّ نَزَلَ‌ۗ وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَـٰكَ إِلَّا مُبَشِّرًا وَنَذِيرًا ۝١٠٥
ayahs.textIndopak: وَبِالْحَقِّ اَنْزَلْنٰهُ وَبِالْحَقِّ نَزَلَؕ وَمَا͏ٓ اَرْسَلْنٰكَ اِلَّا مُبَشِّرًا وَّنَذِيْرًا ۘ
ayahs.translation: And with the truth We have sent it [i.e., the Qur’ān] down, and with the truth it has descended. And We have not sent you, [O Muḥammad], except as a bringer of good tidings and a warner.
ayahs.transliteration: Wabil-haqqi anzalnaahu wabil-haqqi nazala wamaa arsalnaaka illaa mubashshiran wanadheeraa
ayahs.translationClear: With the truth We sent it down, and with the truth it descended. We sent you only as a bearer of good news and a warner.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَقُرْءَانًا فَرَقْنَـٰهُ لِتَقْرَأَهُۥ عَلَى ٱلنَّاسِ عَلَىٰ مُكْثٍ وَنَزَّلْنَـٰهُ تَنزِيلًا
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَقُرْءَانًا فَرَقْنَـٰهُ لِتَقْرَأَهُۥ عَلَى ٱلنَّاسِ عَلَىٰ مُكْثٍ وَنَزَّلْنَـٰهُ تَنزِيلًا ۝١٠٦
ayahs.textIndopak: وَقُرْاٰنًا فَرَقْنٰهُ لِتَقْرَاَهٗ عَلَي النَّاسِ عَلٰي مُكْثٍ وَّنَزَّلْنٰهُ تَنْزِيْلًا
ayahs.translation: And [it is] a Qur’ān which We have separated [by intervals] that you might recite it to the people over a prolonged period. And We have sent it down progressively.
ayahs.transliteration: Waqur'aanan faraqnaahu litaqra'ahoo 'alan-naasi 'alaa mukthin wanazzalnaahu tanzeelaa
ayahs.translationClear: A Quran which We unfolded gradually, that you may recite to the people over time. And We revealed it in stages.

ayahs.textUthmani: قُلْ ءَامِنُوا۟ بِهِۦٓ أَوْ لَا تُؤْمِنُوٓا۟ ۚ إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْعِلْمَ مِن قَبْلِهِۦٓ إِذَا يُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِمْ يَخِرُّونَ لِلْأَذْقَانِ سُجَّدًا
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قُلْ ءَامِنُوا۟ بِهِۦٓ أَوْ لَا تُؤْمِنُوٓا۟‌ۚ إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْعِلْمَ مِن قَبْلِهِۦٓ إِذَا يُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِمْ يَخِرُّونَ لِلْأَذْقَانِ سُجَّدًا ۝١٠٧
ayahs.textIndopak: قُلْ اٰمِنُوْا بِهٖٓ اَوْ لَا تُو͏ٔ͏ْمِنُوْاؕ اِنَّ الَّذِيْنَ اُوْتُوا الْعِلْمَ مِنْ قَبْلِهٖٓ اِذَا يُتْلٰي عَلَيْهِمْ يَخِرُّوْنَ لِلْاَذْقَانِ سُجَّدًا ۙ
ayahs.translation: Say, "Believe in it or do not believe." Indeed, those who were given knowledge before it[777] - when it is recited to them, they fall upon their faces in prostration,
ayahs.transliteration: Qul aaminoo bihee aw laa tu'minoo innal-ladheena ootul-'ilma min qablihee idhaa yutlaa 'alayhim yakhirroona lil'adhqaani sujjadaa

footnotes.777: i.e., the righteous among the People of the Scriptures who recognize the truth contained in the Qur’ān.

ayahs.translationClear: Say, “Believe in it, or do not believe.” Those who were given knowledge before it, when it is recited to them, they fall to their chins, prostrating.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَيَقُولُونَ سُبْحَـٰنَ رَبِّنَآ إِن كَانَ وَعْدُ رَبِّنَا لَمَفْعُولًا
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَيَقُولُونَ سُبْحَـٰنَ رَبِّنَآ إِن كَانَ وَعْدُ رَبِّنَا لَمَفْعُولًا ۝١٠٨
ayahs.textIndopak: وَّيَقُوْلُوْنَ سُبْحٰنَ رَبِّنَا͏ٓ اِنْ كَانَ وَعْدُ رَبِّنَا لَمَفْعُوْلًا
ayahs.translation: And they say, "Exalted is our Lord! Indeed, the promise of our Lord has been fulfilled."
ayahs.transliteration: Wayaqooloona subhaana rabbinaa in kaana wa'du rabbinaa lamaf'oolaa
ayahs.translationClear: And they say, “Glory to our Lord. The promise of our Lord is fulfilled.”

ayahs.textUthmani: وَيَخِرُّونَ لِلْأَذْقَانِ يَبْكُونَ وَيَزِيدُهُمْ خُشُوعًا ۩
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَيَخِرُّونَ لِلْأَذْقَانِ يَبْكُونَ وَيَزِيدُهُمْ خُشُوعًا ۩ ۝١٠٩
ayahs.textIndopak: وَيَخِرُّوْنَ لِلْاَذْقَانِ يَبْكُوْنَ وَيَزِيْدُهُمْ خُشُوْعًا ࣛ
ayahs.translation: And they fall upon their faces weeping, and it [i.e., the Qur’ān] increases them in humble submission.
ayahs.transliteration: Wayakhirroona lil'adhqaani yabkoona wayazeeduhum khushoo'aa
ayahs.translationClear: And they fall to their chins, weeping, and it adds to their humility.

ayahs.textUthmani: قُلِ ٱدْعُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ أَوِ ٱدْعُوا۟ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنَ ۖ أَيًّا مَّا تَدْعُوا۟ فَلَهُ ٱلْأَسْمَآءُ ٱلْحُسْنَىٰ ۚ وَلَا تَجْهَرْ بِصَلَاتِكَ وَلَا تُخَافِتْ بِهَا وَٱبْتَغِ بَيْنَ ذَٰلِكَ سَبِيلًا
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قُلِ ٱدْعُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ أَوِ ٱدْعُوا۟ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنَ‌ۖ أَيًّا مَّا تَدْعُوا۟ فَلَهُ ٱلْأَسْمَآءُ ٱلْحُسْنَىٰ‌ۚ وَلَا تَجْهَرْ بِصَلَاتِكَ وَلَا تُخَافِتْ بِهَا وَٱبْتَغِ بَيْنَ ذَٰلِكَ سَبِيلًا ۝١١٠
ayahs.textIndopak: قُلِ ادْعُوا اللّٰهَ اَوِ ادْعُوا الرَّحْمٰنَؕ اَيًّا مَّا تَدْعُوْا فَلَهُ الْاَسْمَا࢜ءُ الْحُسْنٰيۚ وَلَا تَجْهَرْ بِصَلَاتِكَ وَلَا تُخَافِتْ بِهَا وَابْتَغِ بَيْنَ ذٰلِكَ سَبِيْلًا
ayahs.translation: Say, "Call upon Allāh or call upon the Most Merciful [ar-Raḥmān]. Whichever [name] you call - to Him belong the best names." And do not recite [too] loudly in your prayer or [too] quietly but seek between that an [intermediate] way.
ayahs.transliteration: Qulid'ullaaha awid'ur-rahmaana ayyam maa tad'oo falahul-asmaa'ul-husnaa walaa tajhar bisalaatika walaa tukhaafit bihaa wabtaghi bayna dhaalika sabeelaa
ayahs.translationClear: Say, “Call Him Allah, or call Him the Most Merciful. Whichever name you use, to Him belong the Best Names.” And be neither loud in your prayer, nor silent in it, but follow a course in between.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَقُلِ ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِى لَمْ يَتَّخِذْ وَلَدًا وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُۥ شَرِيكٌ فِى ٱلْمُلْكِ وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُۥ وَلِىٌّ مِّنَ ٱلذُّلِّ ۖ وَكَبِّرْهُ تَكْبِيرًۢا
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَقُلِ ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِى لَمْ يَتَّخِذْ وَلَدًا وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُۥ شَرِيكٌ فِى ٱلْمُلْكِ وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُۥ وَلِىٌّ مِّنَ ٱلذُّلِّ‌ۖ وَكَبِّرْهُ تَكْبِيرًۢا ۝١١١
ayahs.textIndopak: وَقُلِ الْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ الَّذِيْ لَمْ يَتَّخِذْ وَلَدًا وَّلَمْ يَكُنْ لَّهٗ شَرِيْكٌ فِي الْمُلْكِ وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَّهٗ وَلِيٌّ مِّنَ الذُّلِّ وَكَبِّرْهُ تَكْبِيْرًا ࣖ
ayahs.translation: And say, "Praise to Allāh, who has not taken a son and has had no partner in [His] dominion and has no [need of a] protector out of weakness; and glorify Him with [great] glorification."
ayahs.transliteration: Waqulil-hamdu lillaahil-ladhee lam yattakhidh waladan walam yakul lahoo shareekun fil-mulki walam yakul lahoo waliyyum minadh-dhulli wakabbirhu takbeeraa
ayahs.translationClear: And say, “Praise be to Allah, who has not begotten a son, nor has He a partner in sovereignty, nor has He an ally out of weakness, and glorify Him constantly.”
